title: Two Work Packages write the same two story files and two fragments for legacy RWB-AD-003 on rwb-access
source: Work Package files _work/msr/wp/B-P4-02.md and _work/msr/wp/B2-P4-002.md (both list the same 'Write only' paths 04 User stories/Recovery Workbench Service Story Files v1/RWB-SVC-P4 rwb-access (Access and authority)/RWB P4 AD003 APP Scope per role v1.md and RWB P4 AD003 CON Scope per role - contract v1.md, and the same two fragment paths _work/msr/fragments/RWB-P4-AD003-APP.json and RWB-P4-AD003-CON.json); _work/msr/plan/split_plan.json (two slices for legacy RWB-AD-003: RWB-P4-AD003-CON in lane CG-W4 and RWB-P4-AD003-APP in lane L-P4-C, both Day 1, both wave 4, disposition Split (rework)); _work/msr/status.json (no entry for B-P4-02 and no entry for B2-P4-002); _work/msr/gaps/B-P4-02-AD003.part.jsonl and _work/msr/assumptions/B-P4-02-AD003.part.jsonl (the citation set the two delivered files carry)
section: Whole story file set of RWB-AD-003 on rwb-access; fragments _work/msr/fragments/RWB-P4-AD003-APP.json and RWB-P4-AD003-CON.json
description: The plan carries two slices for legacy RWB-AD-003 on rwb-access (the contract baseline and the application slice), but two Work Packages of the run name them: B-P4-02, which lists RWB-AD-003 beside RWB-AD-002, AD-004, AD-005 and AD-006 with fanout 5 and wrote the AD003 key as part of that fanout, and B2-P4-002, which names the same two story files and the same two fragments alone with fanout 0. The four artefacts are present and complete in the tree: the two story files are 62,925 and 50,754 bytes, each with the two header lines of Template and Rules v1 R8.1, a D-RCV-60 change-log row with the tool line, the 20 metadata rows of R7.1 in order, the 19 section headings in order, tables 12.1 to 12.9, the R7.2 Level column in section 16 and no 'As built (monolith)' heading because neither slice is preserved; the APP file carries AC1 and AC2 of RWB-AD-003 word for word with the origin tag and the added Given line of the faked case read, and the CON file carries seven criteria tagged (new, D-RCV-60); the two fragments carry the 28 keys the Work Package lists. Their missing values are already registered once as CG-B-P4-02-AD003-1 and CG-B-P4-02-AD003-2 with ASM-B-P4-02-AD003-1 to ASM-B-P4-02-AD003-8, and every CG and ASM identifier the four artefacts cite resolves to a row in a jsonl file of _work/msr/gaps or _work/msr/assumptions (11 distinct identifiers checked, 0 orphans). The earlier execution left no edit log at _work/msr/editlog/B-P4-02.md and no status entry, so the delivered citation set has no log of its own even though its content is sound. Under root AGENTS.md rule 1 the existing artefacts are kept and this Work Package registers only the duplicate-Work-Package finding, so the Gap Register and the Assumption Register are not allocated twice for one legacy key at step D1 and the sibling files RWB P4 AD002, AD004, AD005 and AD006, which cite the same B-P4-02 set, stay consistent with AD003.
evidence: B-P4-02.md title line 'fanout: 5' and its 'Write only' block with the two RWB P4 AD003 story paths and the RWB-P4-AD003 fragment paths; B2-P4-002.md 'fanout: 0' and the same four paths; split_plan.json slices RWB-P4-AD003-CON (CG-W4) and RWB-P4-AD003-APP (L-P4-C); status.json: no 'B-P4-02' key and no 'B2-P4-002' key; editlog: no B-P4-02 entry; gaps/B-P4-02-AD003.part.jsonl: 2 rows (CG-B-P4-02-AD003-1, CG-B-P4-02-AD003-2, both type Missing, severity P2); assumptions/B-P4-02-AD003.part.jsonl: 8 rows (ASM-B-P4-02-AD003-1 to -8); the four artefacts themselves, read and checked against R7, R7.1, R7.2, R8.1 and R9
proposed: Keep one Work Package per story slice in the plan generator: remove RWB-AD-003 from the B-P4-02 fanout list, or retire B2-P4-002 for this key. At step D1, number CG-B-P4-02-AD003-1 and CG-B-P4-02-AD003-2 and ASM-B-P4-02-AD003-1 to -8 once and allocate no second set for B2-P4-002; ask the B-P4-02 execution to write its edit log row so the delivered AD003 citation set has a traceable writer; add a plan-uniqueness check to checks/run_all.py that fails when two Work Package 'Write only' blocks name the same output path.
